hushgram.title: v0.0.17
hushgram.body:
HushGram moves to Instagram 453.0.0.55.79, and Morphe Manager now knows all four of its builds, so 32-bit phones get pointed at the right one. Stories can play with a seek bar, a thicker progress bar and rounded corners, and reels you open from Home can start with sound. Home can keep your place when you come back, carousels can peek at the next page, and a chat's shared reels can be swiped through in a row. Settings got a new look in Instagram's blues, with sections that open in place, and there's a long list of fixes for downloads, the lock and the glass tab bar.

New in this release

- `Keep your place in Home`: New switch under Feed. Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away. Instagram no longer reloads it or resets the app to the top. Pull down still refreshes. Starts off. Asked for in #354.

- `Glass tab bar`: `Hide the tab bar as you scroll` works with the glass off too. Scroll down and Instagram's own bar slides away while the page fills its space. Scroll up and it's back. Reels keep their bar. Asked for in #343.

- `Rounded post corners`: `Rounded corners on Reels` under Feed rounds a reel's video in the Reels tab and full screen, at the same Corner size. The seek bar, captions and buttons stay whole. Starts off. Asked for in #362.

- `Rounded post corners`: `Rounded corners on stories` under Feed rounds a story's photo or video, whether it opens from the tray, a profile or a highlight, at the same Corner size. The progress bar, names and stickers stay whole. Starts off. Asked for in #363 and #368.

- `Rounded post corners`: `Peek at the next carousel page` under Feed sits each carousel page in from the edges, with the start of the next page showing at the right. Starts off. Asked for in #361.

- `Thicker story progress bar`: new patch. `Thicker story progress bar` under Stories draws the bar along the top of a story twice or three times as thick. Its segments and timing don't change. Starts off. Asked for in #360.

- `Start reels with sound`: new patch. `Start reels with sound` under Playback plays a reel you tap open from a post on Home with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Starts off. Asked for in #342.

- `Pick the app icon`: `App icon` adds Instagram in black on white, a white icon with Instagram's glyph in black. Themed icons still show Instagram's glyph. Asked for in #353.

- `Tab bar layout`: new patch. `Tab bar layout` under Tab bar keeps the newer bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, even when Instagram switches your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Asked for in #356.

- `Lock your messages`: `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` under Messages opens your hidden chats from two quick taps on the Messages button, after the lock when one's on. One tap still opens Messages. Starts off. Asked for in #358.

- `HushGram settings`: A build without Pure black dark mode now says under Layout how to get it: pick it in Morphe Manager next time you patch. Searching settings for "amoled" or "oled" finds it too. Asked for in #359.

- `Download any video`: `Choose a folder` under Downloads sends every photo and video to a folder you pick, a hidden one too, and it works on Android 9 without the storage permission. `Use Movies and Pictures` puts saves back. Asked for in #333.

- `Seek bar on stories`: new patch. `Seek bar on stories` under Stories puts a bar near the bottom of a video story. Drag it to jump anywhere in the video and the story plays on from there. Starts off. Asked for in #355.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels`: new patch. With `Swipe through a chat's reels` on under Messages, swiping up on a reel opened from a chat goes through the chat's other shared reels before any suggested ones. Starts off. Asked for in #350.

- `Hide suggested stories`: `Filter the Stories tray by verified accounts` under Stories keeps only verified accounts in the row at the top of Home, or only the ones that aren't. Your own story stays. Starts off. Asked for in #340.

Fixes

- `Show if a profile follows you`: On your Following list, Doesn't follow you now comes before the name. A long name used to push it off the end of the line. Reported in #351.

- `Hide the emoji row` and `Hide Follow on posts` now work the moment you switch them on. Before, nothing changed until you left Instagram and came back.

- `Hide suggested stories` adds `Keep the Stories tray in the feed` under Stories. On some accounts the row floated over Home mid-feed and stayed put while posts scrolled under it. Now it stays in the feed. Starts off. Reported in #357.

- Morphe Manager now knows the armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64 builds of Instagram too, so an older 32-bit phone is pointed at the build it can install instead of the arm64 one. Reported in #346.

- `Glass tab bar` no longer leaves a dark band under a reel opened from the feed, where Instagram hides the tab bar. Reels opened from the Reels tab still stop above the bar. Reported in #347.

- `Start stories with sound` turns Instagram's sound back off when you leave a story, so Feed and Reels stay muted. Coming back to the story turns it on again, and a story you muted yourself stays muted. Reported in #342.

- `Download any story` also adds Download to the menu of your own highlights, which Instagram builds differently from other story menus. Reported in #339.

- `Hide Follow on feed posts` also filters Subscribe before the feed header builds it. The author's name, time and menu keep their native paths.

- `Tap to play` keeps a Reels auto-scroll allowance for the next Reel. Feed and unidentified players can't spend it, and a real tap on Feed still works.

- `Group Instagram's notifications` keeps summaries while their notifications remain. Turning grouping off or removing one notification no longer dismisses the others. Pending posts stay protected while Android catches up. One notification uses the singular count label.

- Turning off profile posts as a list, or pausing HushGram, cancels an automatic opening that was still waiting for the grid.

- Canceling a download can finish while DNS, proxy discovery or response setup is still waiting. Late responses can't write a file, and repeated cancellations keep a bounded number of workers.

- The downloader closes opened response streams on success and failure. Cache bytes stay only after a successful close.

- Closing `Save profile picture` stops its fetch even when the general background workers are busy.

- `Download any video` adds source metadata to JPEG photos saved through Save all and Choose pages, as it does for a single photo. Videos and other image formats stay unchanged.

- Download history repairs a partially written record before its next write. Later saves remain listed after a restart.

- A failed PIN save keeps the setup form open and reports the failure. The PIN and its retry counters are saved together.

- PIN retry limits still apply in the current process when their counters can't be saved.

- `HushGram settings` saves a timed lock and its wait together. Lock, unlock and wait actions no longer report success after a failed write.

- `HushGram settings` checks the current lock before an editor or delayed action saves. Imports and Undo check again at their write boundary, and a held Undo remains available until its original deadline.

- Font imports finish reading and closing their provider before replacing a live font. Failed or stale imports leave the current files alone, and reopening settings can't start a competing copy.

- Replacing an imported app font keeps Restart now available even when the font choice hasn't changed.

- Settings backups restore large selections of hidden Instagram settings rows. Selecting all 161 supported rows no longer causes that choice to be skipped.

- `Hide suggested posts` keeps native paging when a filtered page retains a real post, even before its list is displayed. Header-only pages can still finish.

- `Glass tab bar` blur recovers after a temporary capture failure on a still screen. Automatic retries stay bounded, and pending work stops when the bar leaves or HushGram pauses.

- `Story text fonts` puts local fonts before Instagram's paid section, so selecting one doesn't open a Plus offer. Instagram's paid fonts keep their subscription checks. Reported in #275 and #325.

- `View stories anonymously` keeps your own story, Create and special tray entries in their original positions during watched-story sorting. Ordinary story rings keep their order within the unseen and watched groups.

- `HushGram settings` requires Android 9 on every ABI, including the two 32-bit APKs Instagram ships for Android 8. Manifest checks verify that floor and preserve any higher vendor minimum.

- `Show if a profile follows you` waits for unique followers to match the account's count before recording recent unfollowers. Short lists and older queued saves can't replace a newer snapshot, and failed saves can be retried.

- `HushGram settings` lets go of a closed screen or dialog. The moving title used to keep every one you'd opened in memory until Instagram restarted.

- `Convert to keep the full size` asks the phone's encoder for limited range BT.709 color. Left to choose, some encoders write a file other apps show with shifted colors.

Other changes

- HushGram now patches Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 instead of 452.1.0.53.64. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) variant, build 385914283. The armeabi-v7a build (385914282) is declared too, and so are the x86 and x86_64 builds (385914284 and 385914285). Thanks to toidicakhia for #366.

- HushGram's settings use Instagram's own blues instead of pink. Switches and buttons take its indigo button color, while icons and headings use the lighter blue Instagram gives links on a dark screen.

- Every HushGram title wears Instagram's gradient now, including the settings bar, its dialogs and the lock screen. The colors drift slowly and a sheen sweeps across every few seconds, even with Android's animations turned off.

- Settings categories expand their controls directly underneath. Several sections can stay open, and tapping a heading collapses it. Search finds controls across every section and restores your open sections when cleared.

- Settings put switches with the screen they change. The Notifications page's suggestion switches moved to Notifications, the Reels tab's to Tab bar, and anonymous DM photos to Messages. Searching their old section still finds them.

- The Updates section in settings is now called Version warnings, since all it holds is the switch for Instagram's "this version is too old" screen. Searching for Updates still finds it.

- Settings open on Ads and privacy now. Settings entry moved down next to backup and the other upkeep sections, after the everyday controls.

- Pause and diagnostics folds like the other sections now, so Debug logging and the report rows don't fill the overview. It opens by itself while HushGram is paused, the settings are locked or a save was interrupted.

- Settings opens with Search, the list view option and a compact category list with shorter descriptions. Quick setups and the active-status banner are gone. Larger text still wraps.

- Download file names support `{shortcode}`, using the parent post's code for carousel pages. Unknown codes are left out. Photo names use the template when it includes that token.

- `Date in backup file names` adds the local date and time to settings exports. It starts off, keeping the existing backup name until enabled.

- Added Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), contributed by JhouHank in #313. Traditional Chinese script preferences and Hong Kong or Macao locales use the new table.

- Hide the emoji row, Hide Follow on posts, Rounded corners on Reels and Thicker story progress bar now share one check before each frame. With several on, Instagram does that work once per frame instead of once for each.

Behind the scenes

- Cached patch lookups now refresh when classes are added, replaced or removed. Unchanged classes keep their cached reads.

- Release walkthroughs require matching bundle, candidate and installed APK evidence, with visible content for each required destination. Incomplete receipts, changed installs and covered pages can't authorize publication.

- Walk navigation checks the chosen tap point, including covers over a partly visible control. Settings labels keep their own location when a row handles the tap.

- The walk accepts a loaded Explore grid under Instagram's empty Compose layer. A labeled, clickable, focusable, filled or differently built layer still counts as a cover.

- The release walk expands each settings category in place and checks it folds again, since Back now closes settings. A row only counts under its own heading, and every row is checked against the settings source.

- The source census keeps a relicensed source's old licence pinned and records code it took from elsewhere. InstaEclipse is GPL-3.0 now, and the HushGram downloader it carries counts as ours. Stylus dropped its Instagram patch.

- The build moves to the Morphe patches plugin 2.0.0 and Kotlin 2.4.21, held to one version across the plugin's classpath. Patched apps come out the same, and the bundle carries Kotlin stdlib 2.4.21.

- The patching help explains the small-heap limit and keeps Manager's embedded VM workaround.

- Updated to Morphe patcher 2.0.1 and its matching Smali library. Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer is required. The dependency audit separately reviews Morphe Desktop 1.19.1.

- GitHub release notes now read like Hushfacebook's. A short summary comes first, then plain grouped bullets with no Instagram label, the update steps and what was checked.

- The bundle now carries Gson 2.15.0. The patch catalog comes out byte for byte the same, and new tests hold its key order, nulls and unescaped text, including emoji.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.2.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `453.0.0.55.79`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

6891 runtime tests passed locally. All 2181 patch tests passed too.

All four Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 builds took 122 of the 123 patches, everything but Install next to Instagram, which makes a second app. I patched Instagram with this exact bundle and walked the whole app on an emulator: the feed, Explore, Reels, the inbox, a profile and every section of HushGram's settings, 29 screens in all, and Instagram didn't crash once.

- `Pick the app icon`: `App icon` adds Instagram in black on white, a white icon with Instagram's glyph in black. Themed icons still show Instagram's glyph. Asked for in #353.

- `Tab bar layout`: new patch. `Tab bar layout` under Tab bar keeps the newer bar, where you swipe between every tab, or the classic one, even when Instagram switches your account. Starts on Instagram's choice. Asked for in #356.

- `Lock your messages`: `Double-tap Messages for hidden chats` under Messages opens your hidden chats from two quick taps on the Messages button, after the lock when one's on. One tap still opens Messages. Starts off. Asked for in #358.

- `HushGram settings`: A build without Pure black dark mode now says under Layout how to get it: pick it in Morphe Manager next time you patch. Searching settings for "amoled" or "oled" finds it too. Asked for in #359.

- `Download any video`: `Choose a folder` under Downloads sends every photo and video to a folder you pick, a hidden one too, and it works on Android 9 without the storage permission. `Use Movies and Pictures` puts saves back. Asked for in #333.

- `Seek bar on stories`: new patch. `Seek bar on stories` under Stories puts a bar near the bottom of a video story. Drag it to jump anywhere in the video and the story plays on from there. Starts off. Asked for in #355.

- `Swipe through a chat's reels`: new patch. With `Swipe through a chat's reels` on under Messages, swiping up on a reel opened from a chat goes through the chat's other shared reels before any suggested ones. Starts off. Asked for in #350.

- `Hide suggested stories`: `Filter the Stories tray by verified accounts` under Stories keeps only verified accounts in the row at the top of Home, or only the ones that aren't. Your own story stays. Starts off. Asked for in #340.

Fixes

- `Show if a profile follows you`: On your Following list, Doesn't follow you now comes before the name. A long name used to push it off the end of the line. Reported in #351.

- `Hide the emoji row` and `Hide Follow on posts` now work the moment you switch them on. Before, nothing changed until you left Instagram and came back.

- `Hide suggested stories` adds `Keep the Stories tray in the feed` under Stories. On some accounts the row floated over Home mid-feed and stayed put while posts scrolled under it. Now it stays in the feed. Starts off. Reported in #357.

- Morphe Manager now knows the armeabi-v7a, x86 and x86_64 builds of Instagram too, so an older 32-bit phone is pointed at the build it can install instead of the arm64 one. Reported in #346.

- `Glass tab bar` no longer leaves a dark band under a reel opened from the feed, where Instagram hides the tab bar. Reels opened from the Reels tab still stop above the bar. Reported in #347.

- `Start stories with sound` turns Instagram's sound back off when you leave a story, so Feed and Reels stay muted. Coming back to the story turns it on again, and a story you muted yourself stays muted. Reported in #342.

- `Download any story` also adds Download to the menu of your own highlights, which Instagram builds differently from other story menus. Reported in #339.

- `Hide Follow on feed posts` also filters Subscribe before the feed header builds it. The author's name, time and menu keep their native paths.

- `Tap to play` keeps a Reels auto-scroll allowance for the next Reel. Feed and unidentified players can't spend it, and a real tap on Feed still works.

- `Group Instagram's notifications` keeps summaries while their notifications remain. Turning grouping off or removing one notification no longer dismisses the others. Pending posts stay protected while Android catches up. One notification uses the singular count label.

- Turning off profile posts as a list, or pausing HushGram, cancels an automatic opening that was still waiting for the grid.

- Canceling a download can finish while DNS, proxy discovery or response setup is still waiting. Late responses can't write a file, and repeated cancellations keep a bounded number of workers.

- The downloader closes opened response streams on success and failure. Cache bytes stay only after a successful close.

- Closing `Save profile picture` stops its fetch even when the general background workers are busy.

- `Download any video` adds source metadata to JPEG photos saved through Save all and Choose pages, as it does for a single photo. Videos and other image formats stay unchanged.

- Download history repairs a partially written record before its next write. Later saves remain listed after a restart.

- A failed PIN save keeps the setup form open and reports the failure. The PIN and its retry counters are saved together.

- PIN retry limits still apply in the current process when their counters can't be saved.

- `HushGram settings` saves a timed lock and its wait together. Lock, unlock and wait actions no longer report success after a failed write.

- `HushGram settings` checks the current lock before an editor or delayed action saves. Imports and Undo check again at their write boundary, and a held Undo remains available until its original deadline.

- Font imports finish reading and closing their provider before replacing a live font. Failed or stale imports leave the current files alone, and reopening settings can't start a competing copy.

- Replacing an imported app font keeps Restart now available even when the font choice hasn't changed.

- Settings backups restore large selections of hidden Instagram settings rows. Selecting all 161 supported rows no longer causes that choice to be skipped.

- `Hide suggested posts` keeps native paging when a filtered page retains a real post, even before its list is displayed. Header-only pages can still finish.

- `Glass tab bar` blur recovers after a temporary capture failure on a still screen. Automatic retries stay bounded, and pending work stops when the bar leaves or HushGram pauses.

- `Story text fonts` puts local fonts before Instagram's paid section, so selecting one doesn't open a Plus offer. Instagram's paid fonts keep their subscription checks. Reported in #275 and #325.

- `View stories anonymously` keeps your own story, Create and special tray entries in their original positions during watched-story sorting. Ordinary story rings keep their order within the unseen and watched groups.

- `HushGram settings` requires Android 9 on every ABI, including the two 32-bit APKs Instagram ships for Android 8. Manifest checks verify that floor and preserve any higher vendor minimum.

- `Show if a profile follows you` waits for unique followers to match the account's count before recording recent unfollowers. Short lists and older queued saves can't replace a newer snapshot, and failed saves can be retried.

- `HushGram settings` lets go of a closed screen or dialog. The moving title used to keep every one you'd opened in memory until Instagram restarted.

- `Convert to keep the full size` asks the phone's encoder for limited range BT.709 color. Left to choose, some encoders write a file other apps show with shifted colors.

Other changes

- HushGram now patches Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 instead of 452.1.0.53.64. Get APKMirror's (arm64-v8a) (480-640dpi) (Android 9.0+) variant, build 385914283. The armeabi-v7a build (385914282) is declared too, and so are the x86 and x86_64 builds (385914284 and 385914285). Thanks to toidicakhia for #366.

- HushGram's settings use Instagram's own blues instead of pink. Switches and buttons take its indigo button color, while icons and headings use the lighter blue Instagram gives links on a dark screen.

- Every HushGram title wears Instagram's gradient now, including the settings bar, its dialogs and the lock screen. The colors drift slowly and a sheen sweeps across every few seconds, even with Android's animations turned off.

- Settings categories expand their controls directly underneath. Several sections can stay open, and tapping a heading collapses it. Search finds controls across every section and restores your open sections when cleared.

- Settings put switches with the screen they change. The Notifications page's suggestion switches moved to Notifications, the Reels tab's to Tab bar, and anonymous DM photos to Messages. Searching their old section still finds them.

- The Updates section in settings is now called Version warnings, since all it holds is the switch for Instagram's "this version is too old" screen. Searching for Updates still finds it.

- Settings open on Ads and privacy now. Settings entry moved down next to backup and the other upkeep sections, after the everyday controls.

- Pause and diagnostics folds like the other sections now, so Debug logging and the report rows don't fill the overview. It opens by itself while HushGram is paused, the settings are locked or a save was interrupted.

- Settings opens with Search, the list view option and a compact category list with shorter descriptions. Quick setups and the active-status banner are gone. Larger text still wraps.

- Download file names support `{shortcode}`, using the parent post's code for carousel pages. Unknown codes are left out. Photo names use the template when it includes that token.

- `Date in backup file names` adds the local date and time to settings exports. It starts off, keeping the existing backup name until enabled.

- Added Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), contributed by JhouHank in #313. Traditional Chinese script preferences and Hong Kong or Macao locales use the new table.

- Hide the emoji row, Hide Follow on posts, Rounded corners on Reels and Thicker story progress bar now share one check before each frame. With several on, Instagram does that work once per frame instead of once for each.

Behind the scenes

- Cached patch lookups now refresh when classes are added, replaced or removed. Unchanged classes keep their cached reads.

- Release walkthroughs require matching bundle, candidate and installed APK evidence, with visible content for each required destination. Incomplete receipts, changed installs and covered pages can't authorize publication.

- Walk navigation checks the chosen tap point, including covers over a partly visible control. Settings labels keep their own location when a row handles the tap.

- The walk accepts a loaded Explore grid under Instagram's empty Compose layer. A labeled, clickable, focusable, filled or differently built layer still counts as a cover.

- The release walk expands each settings category in place and checks it folds again, since Back now closes settings. A row only counts under its own heading, and every row is checked against the settings source.

- The source census keeps a relicensed source's old licence pinned and records code it took from elsewhere. InstaEclipse is GPL-3.0 now, and the HushGram downloader it carries counts as ours. Stylus dropped its Instagram patch.

- The build moves to the Morphe patches plugin 2.0.0 and Kotlin 2.4.21, held to one version across the plugin's classpath. Patched apps come out the same, and the bundle carries Kotlin stdlib 2.4.21.

- The patching help explains the small-heap limit and keeps Manager's embedded VM workaround.

- Updated to Morphe patcher 2.0.1 and its matching Smali library. Morphe Manager 2.2.0 or newer is required. The dependency audit separately reviews Morphe Desktop 1.19.1.

- GitHub release notes now read like Hushfacebook's. A short summary comes first, then plain grouped bullets with no Instagram label, the update steps and what was checked.

- The bundle now carries Gson 2.15.0. The patch catalog comes out byte for byte the same, and new tests hold its key order, nulls and unescaped text, including emoji.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.2.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `453.0.0.55.79`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

6891 runtime tests passed locally. All 2181 patch tests passed too.

All four Instagram 453.0.0.55.79 builds took 122 of the 123 patches, everything but Install next to Instagram, which makes a second app. I patched Instagram with this exact bundle and walked the whole app on an emulator: the feed, Explore, Reels, the inbox, a profile and every section of HushGram's settings, 29 screens in all, and Instagram didn't crash once.

hushpinterest.title: v0.0.13
hushpinterest.body:
HushPinterest 0.0.13 has 33 patches for Pinterest 14.41.0. It's the first one built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.0.0 or newer before you patch. Older Manager builds can't open this bundle.

The new patch is GmsCore support, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It sends Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications through microG-RE. It isn't picked by default, so if you don't use microG-RE nothing changes for you.

Patch 14.41.0 with the same signing key you used before and install it over your current HushPinterest. Your settings stay as they are.

## What's new

- New GmsCore support patch, for phones that run microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pinterest's Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE, so Continue with Google opens microG-RE's sign-in. Before, it asked Play services and the account got turned down. It's left out of the default selection since without microG-RE those requests have nowhere to go. Pick it in Expert mode and Spoof signature for Google sign-in comes along with it. (#15)
- The patches are now built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer to apply them. Older Manager builds can't load the bundle.

## Behind the scenes

- A release can't go public until the whole app has been walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before GitHub or the index if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Pinterest crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- A device lease another session happens to be reading no longer stops a run partway. The check waits a moment and tries again, and a lease that stays locked still stops it.
- New `scripts/walk-app.ps1` patches Pinterest from the release bundle and installs it on a leased phone or emulator. Then it opens the home feed, the patched screens and every Hush settings page, and writes the receipt publish asks for. Only a full walk with no Pinterest crash earns a PASS.

## Install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest 14.41.0, version code `14418010`. APKMirror has it as an arm64-v8a bundle (`.apkm`) for Android 12L or newer. Pick that file in Manager and it merges the parts before patching.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap `Forgot your password?` on Pinterest's login page to set one first. On a phone with microG-RE, pick GmsCore support when you patch and Continue with Google goes to microG-RE's sign-in instead.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

Already on HushPinterest? Update Manager, then skip steps 4 and 5. Patch 14.41.0 with the same key and install it over the one you have.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Reported issues

- #15: GmsCore support is new in this release, for signing in with Google on a phone that has microG-RE instead of Play services.

## Validation

All 241 patch tests and 1069 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.41.0 bundle from APKMirror with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 33 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.13.json` records that result, the bundle's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Before release, this exact bundle patched a Pinterest that went on an Android emulator for a walk through the whole app: the home feed, a pin, notifications, searches for pins, boards and people, and all ten HushPinterest settings pages. Pinterest didn't crash once.

GmsCore support was tried on an emulator with microG-RE installed. Pinterest opened microG-RE's Google sign-in at launch, and Continue with Google went on to microG-RE's account screen. That emulator had no Google account added, so a full sign-in wasn't done there.

hushtelegram.title: v0.0.22
hushtelegram.body:
HushTelegram v0.0.22 has 67 patches for the Google Play build of Telegram 13.1.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72371) and telegram.org's Telegram 13.1.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72299). It's built on Morphe patcher 2.1.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.3.0 or newer before you patch. Most of this one came straight from your reports. There's a Ghost mode for read receipts and stories, a switch that blocks new channels and groups for a kid's phone, and Copy, Save to Downloads and Forward as copy for chats that don't allow saving. You can hide reactions and the reaction picker, unlock the Premium app icons, and pick an emoji status that only your phone sees. Full screen videos stay full screen when you turn the phone upright, and reactions to your messages notify you now on builds Google's push doesn't reach. Every new switch starts off.

New in this release

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has one more switch, `Add Forward as copy to the message menu`, off by default. With it on, a message in a chat that doesn't allow forwarding gets a Forward as copy item. Pick a chat and the message's text, or its downloaded photo or file, goes there as a new message. Media you haven't downloaded yet asks you to open it first. (#46, #47)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has another new switch, `Add Save to Downloads to the message menu`, off by default. With it on, a photo, video, file or song you've already downloaded from a chat that doesn't allow saving gets a Save to Downloads item in its long-press menu. Tap it and the file is copied to Download/Telegram. Nothing is copied until you tap, even with the two automatic save switches off. (#29)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch under it, `Copy text from chats that don't allow saving`, off by default. Turn it on and a message in a chat or channel that blocks saving gets a Copy item in its long-press menu, and you can select its text and copy it like anywhere else. Forwarding, screenshots and the rest of the restriction stay as they are. (#43)

- `Disable double-tap reactions` has two new switches under it, both off by default. `Hide reactions under messages` stops the row of reactions from being drawn under each message, and `Hide the reaction picker` removes the row of reactions at the top of the long-press menu along with the panel it opens. Nothing stored is changed, so turning a switch off brings everything back. Tags in Saved Messages still show. (#48)

- `Hide recommendations` has a new switch under it, `Hide trending packs`, off by default. Turn it on and the sticker keyboard loses its Trending tab and the trending row under your packs, and the emoji keyboard stops listing packs you haven't added. Search still finds new packs, and the Stickers and Emoji screen in Settings still shows Telegram's trending list.

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` has a new switch under it, `Hide emoji statuses`, off by default. Turn it on and the emoji a Premium account puts next to its name is gone from chats, the chat list and profiles, so you see the plain Premium star instead. Your own status hides on your phone too, but everyone else still sees it. Picking a new status for a channel you run still saves.

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` also has `Unlock Premium app icons`, off by default. With it on, Premium, Turbo and Nox in Telegram's App Icon list (Settings, Appearance) have no lock and switch your home screen icon like the others, instead of opening the Premium sheet. They show in the list even where Telegram sells no Premium. Only the icon on your phone changes. (#13, #14)

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` also has `Emoji status on this phone`, off by default. With it on, the star next to Telegram at the top of the chat list opens the emoji status picker without Premium, and the emoji you pick, animated ones too, shows there on your phone. Nobody else sees it and nothing goes to Telegram. Picking no status puts the star back. (#14)

- `HushTelegram icon and name` has an `Icon style` option in Morphe Manager. Besides the blue badge you can pick `White on black` or `Black on white`, which draw just the H and plane in one color. The plain styles need Android 8 or newer, and Android 13's themed icon still works with any of them. (#37)

- `Hide channel bar buttons` has a new switch under it, `Hide channel share button`, off by default. With it on, the round share button beside channel posts goes away, in the channel itself and in any chat a channel post gets forwarded to. A post's own menu still forwards it. Bots, people's media in public groups and Saved Messages keep their button.

- `Stop usage reports` has a new switch under it, `Ghost mode`, off by default. It has two parts, `No read receipts` and `View stories anonymously`, which start on. With Ghost mode on, people don't see the messages you read as read, in private chats, groups and secret chats, and voice messages you play stay unplayed for them. Stories you watch don't add you to the viewer list. Sending a message in a chat still marks it read, since Telegram does that on its side, and your other devices keep showing chats you read here as unread. The diagnostic report counts the read receipts and story views it kept back. (#45)

- `Hide popular apps` has a new switch under it, `Block new channels and groups`, off by default. It's meant as a parental control. With it on, joining a channel or group doesn't go through, whether it's from search, an invite link or a shared folder link, and a channel or group you aren't in won't open, forums included. A short message says new chats are blocked in the HushTelegram settings. Chats you're already in work as before. Turn on `Lock HushTelegram settings` too, or the switch can just be turned off again. On a blocked invite or folder link, Telegram also says it can't find the group or folder. The diagnostic report counts the joins and chats it stopped. (#44)

- Reactions to your messages now show a notification on patched builds, which Google's push never reaches. `UnifiedPush notifications` has a new switch under it, `Reaction notifications without push`, on by default. While Telegram is connected, someone reacting to one of your messages gets the same "reacted to your message" notification Telegram shows from a push, once per reaction. Telegram's own `Reactions` switch in Notifications and Sounds still has to be on. (#41)

Fixes

- With `Full screen videos turn either way` or `Turn videos only from the full screen button` on, turning your phone upright no longer takes a video out of full screen. Telegram ends full screen on its own once the phone has been on its side and comes back upright, which with either switch on left the video standing up and stuck that way until you tapped the button again. Full screen now lasts until you tap the button or close the video. (#27)

- When a settings editor can't save what you typed, the reason under the field stays on screen at large text sizes with the keyboard up. The cursor used to scroll it right back out of sight.

- The API key field in `Translation service` uses the same letters as the fields above it. Its hint used to show in a typewriter font.

hushthreads.title: v0.0.16
hushthreads.body:
HushThreads v0.0.16 has 20 patches for Threads 452.0.0.50.64 (`com.instagram.barcelona`), and it patches that version only. It's built on Morphe patcher 2.0.0, so you need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer. Update Threads to 452 before you patch.

Hide ads now also goes after the ads Threads fetches for the replies under an opened post. There's a new `Disable swipe to Search` patch too, for accounts where a sideways swipe on the feed slides into Search.

**Your reports in this release**

- [#12](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/12) found ads among the replies when you open a post. Those come with the post rather than through the feed, and Hide ads now empties that list as well.
- [#13](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads/issues/13) asked for a way to stop the feed sliding into Search on a sideways swipe. Turn on `No swipe into Search` on the Feed page and restart Threads. The Search button still works.

## Threads

- HushThreads now patches Threads 452.0.0.50.64 only, the newest stable version, and drops 451.0.0.51.80. Update Threads to 452 before you patch. The bundle is built with Morphe's 2.0 patcher, so you'll need Morphe Manager 2.0.0 or newer.
- Hide ads now also takes out the ads that show up among the replies when you open a post. Threads sends those with the post instead of through your feed, which is how they slipped past before. Turn Hide ads off, or pause HushThreads, and they show the way Threads draws them. The Hide ads switch says so in all six languages.
- New `Disable swipe to Search` patch. On accounts where a sideways swipe on your feed slides into Search, the swipe stops and your feed stays put. The Search button still opens Search. Only some accounts have the swipe, and on the others nothing changes. The `No swipe into Search` switch is on the Feed page of HushThreads settings and starts off. Restart Threads after you flip it.
- A download that runs out of its ten minutes now always says it was too slow. Every so often its last wait ended a fraction of a millisecond early, and you were told the network failed instead.

## Tooling

- A release can't go public until the whole app is walked with that exact bundle on a release phone or an emulator. The publish stage now takes the walk's receipt as `-Walk` and stops before the tag or GitHub if the walk wasn't a full pass, saw a Threads crash, ran on some other device, or patched with a different bundle.
- `scripts/walk-app.ps1` does that walk. It patches Threads from the release bundle and installs it, opens the feed, Search, Activity, a profile and a post by their links, then goes in through the Profile tab, the profile's Settings button and the HushThreads row in Threads' settings and opens every HushThreads settings page. A screen only counts when Threads shows that screen's own view, since a link Threads doesn't handle still opens Threads, on the feed. Any Threads crash or ANR since the walk began fails it, and the receipt it writes is the one publish asks for. Its only taps are those three steps and the settings rows, each checked on its own screen, so it can't follow, block or message anyone, or like a post.

## Update

1. You need [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.0.0 or newer. If HushThreads is already one of your patch sources, Manager shows 0.0.16 once it refreshes. If it isn't, add it: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushThreads
2. Get Threads 452.0.0.50.64 (arm64-v8a, version code 512207626) and patch that. v0.0.15 was the last release for Threads 451.
3. Manager's default selection has every patch except `Change version code`, `Remove share targets` and `Trust user-added certificates`. Turn on Expert mode if you want any of those.
4. Patch with the Morphe Manager signing key you used last time. That's what lets the update install over your patched Threads and keep your data and your login. Coming from the stock Threads, uninstall it first.
5. On a fresh install, sign in with your Instagram username and password.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Threads APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushThreads#install).

## Validation

1004 runtime tests and 287 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lints and the release script checks. All 20 patches applied without forcing to Threads 452.0.0.50.64, and the release receipt records the run. The dependency advisory check passed.

jasonwu.body:
### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **Gboard:** fix the occasionally blank shortcut toolbar when opening the keyboard with Rambler enabled.
* **Gboard:** remove the `Hyperspeed Typing Animation` patch because Gboard 18.5.3 no longer includes its core implementation.
* **Gboard:** fix runtime settings access before the first unlock after boot to prevent errors when swiping down to dismiss the keyboard.
* **Gboard:** fix the `Zhuyin Bottom Row Key Sizes` patch so bottom-row keys retain their configured sizes while typing on the Zhuyin keyboard.
* **Gboard:** eliminate brief white or dark background flashes when opening or switching keyboards with custom opacity enabled.
* **Gboard:** fix black borders around keyboard corners when adjusting custom opacity.

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **Gboard:** update the supported Gboard version to `18.5.4.993608717-release-arm64-v8a`.

### 🐛 修復

* **Gboard:** 修復啟用 Rambler 時，開啟鍵盤後快捷工具列偶爾空白的問題。
* **Gboard:** 移除 `Hyperspeed Typing Animation` Patch，因 Gboard 18.5.3 已移除所需的核心實作。
* **Gboard:** 修復開機後首次解鎖前，向下滑動關閉鍵盤功能存取設定時可能發生的錯誤。
* **Gboard:** 修復「注音底排按鍵大小」Patch 在注音輸入時無法維持自訂按鍵大小的問題。
* **Gboard:** 修復啟用自訂透明度後，開啟或切換鍵盤時背景短暫閃白或閃黑的問題。
* **Gboard:** 修復調整自訂透明度時，鍵盤邊角出現黑邊的問題。

### 🚀 支援版本更新

* **Gboard:** 更新支援的 Gboard 版本至 `18.5.4.993608717-release-arm64-v8a`。
